# flutter_local_notifications

**Tag**: mobile

## 简介

A cross platform plugin for displaying and scheduling local notifications for Flutter applications with the ability to customise for each platform.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/MaikuB/flutter_local_notifications/tree/master/flutter_local_notifications
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/MaikuB/flutter_local_notifications/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_local_notifications
